blocks.text: Lipids jaanwaron aur paudon mein milne wale organic compounds ki qism hain jis mein charbi aur teil, phospholipids (jaise cell ki jhilliyon mein), steroids aur terpenes (khushbudar teil) shamil hain. Polysaccharides aur proteins ke baraks lipids polymers nahi: in mein koi dohrane wala monomer unit nahi. Yeh hydrophobic hain lekin organic solvents mein ghulte hain. Lipids eendhan molecules, signal molecules, jhilli ke ajza, hormones aur cells ke andar paigham rasaan ka kaam karte hain. Inhein simple, compound aur derived lipids mein taqseem kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Lipids ko polymers kyun nahi kaha jata?
blocks.explanation: Yeh dohrane wale monomer unit se nahi bante.

items: Lipids: charbi, teil, phospholipids, steroids, terpenes; hydrophobic; polymers nahi.
